ALL_BI_REPLACE.inventory: all original CAL46; fixed-native compatible44 only
ALL_BI_REPLACE.reference_phase: fixed geometry-only ALIGN._reference_alignment; no pose-error choice
ALL_BI_REPLACE.group: one physical native edge; one deterministic graphselected actual TLS line; all other alternatives are archive only
ALL_BI_REPLACE.component_prior: equal total mass per distinct support; equal split among its distinct exact fitted variants
ALL_BI_REPLACE.support_anchor: actual unweighted inlier centroid projected onto saved weighted-TLS line; same runtime gauge
ALL_BI_REPLACE.residual: normal offset at support anchor and unoriented angular sine
ALL_BI_REPLACE.normal_floor: fn=max(1 pixel, actual inlier RMS); variance=fn^2
ALL_BI_REPLACE.weighting: equal supported sessions, equal supported frames within session, equal physical edges within frame
ALL_BI_REPLACE.estimator: uncentered radial-pseudo-Huber mixture NLL with covariance log volume
ALL_BI_REPLACE.optimizer: L-BFGS-B on nonnegative scaled variance components
ALL_BI_REPLACE.prior_used_in: uncentered NLL, variance gradient, optimizer conditioning weightedmedians, LOGO heldout NLL, runtime mixture
ALL_BI_REPLACE.replacement: v29 image-supported native physical-edge normal replaces q normal once; one direction keeps archived q in selected actual-line tangent; finite ordered nonparallel pair removes full q cost; no new owner preserves v26 measurement state: nonfallback q2D, fallback legacy normal+T4
ALL_BI_REPLACE.one_direction_complete_tangent: separate new active-population gamma model; original q/effective covariance/reliability retained; selected actual measured-line tangent fixed before labels
ALL_BI_REPLACE.source_17c_guard_policy: new full-provenance engineering partial source; any superseded old endpoint/shift guard is explicit, never renamed a passing old17c measurement
ALL_BI_REPLACE.search_angle_reference: per-chain actual generating guide, with immutable ORIGINAL angle retained separately; never interpreted as independent measured direction
ALL_BI_REPLACE.graph_population: exact deterministic graphselected runtime population sealed before CAL labels; no label-dependent line selection
